welcome.heroTagline: Making AGI accessible to every creator
welcome.heroDescription: ARF is a local-first Agent framework where models, skills, and tools are abstracted as equal resources. A lightweight combination of local filesystem + embedded database powers a living system with long-term memory and resource self-orchestration.
welcome.footer: ARF v0.7 · Local-first AI Agent Framework · Open Source
welcome.tributeQuote: Unswayed by praise, undaunted by slander — stay true to the path, hold yourself upright.
welcome.tributeQuoteAttr: — The long-termist conviction of the DeepSeek team
welcome.tributeBody: Saluting DeepSeek and all open-source explorers. You have proven that without vast resources, through radical architectural innovation and tenacious engineering, AI can be pushed to the frontier — from dramatically strengthened Agent capabilities to accessible million-token context windows. This steady commitment to "advancing through trial and reflection" has illuminated the path for countless developers. We are inheritors of this open-source and democratizing force, and co-builders of its ecosystem.
welcome.visionIntro: We don't just gaze at the stars — we want to pave the road to them.
welcome.visionCardBody: To make Artificial General Intelligence not a privilege of the technical elite, but a tool within reach of every creator. We remain committed to long-termism, advancing steadily toward the goal of AGI.
welcome.missionCardBody: To fundamentally reshape how Agent applications are built. In this framework, models, skills, and tools are all abstracted as equal "resources." Through a lightweight combination of local filesystem + SQLite, we build a living system with long-term memory and resource self-orchestration — one that not only understands your world but remembers it, making complex technology accessible in its simplest form.
welcome.eorIntro: We have re-examined the logic of Agent construction. Departing from traditional hard-coded development, we decompose complexity entirely:
welcome.eorModelDesc: Beyond compute — pluggable intelligence resources. Top-tier models auto-connected out of the box.
welcome.eorSkillDesc: Reusable, composable capability resources. Snap together like building blocks — no more reinventing the wheel.
welcome.eorToolDesc: Action resources bridging the digital and physical worlds. Enabling Agents to see, hear, search, and act.
welcome.eorMemoryDesc: Local filesystem + SQLite based long-term memory — your Agent doesn't just know more, it remembers you. When tasks arrive, the Agent automatically retrieves, understands, and orchestrates these resources to accomplish the goal.
welcome.eorConclusion: This is the future we envision: a truly self-evolving, ready-to-use Agent framework.
welcome.goal1Desc: No more cumbersome configs or expensive infrastructure. "If you can turn it on, you can use it" — everyone should be able to build their own AI agent.
welcome.goal2Desc: Cost-controlled, permanently retained local storage. Your data always belongs to you.
welcome.goal3Desc: The Agent learns to fend for itself. Given a vague instruction, the system autonomously decides which model, skill, and tool to invoke — dynamically assembling the optimal solution.
welcome.goal4Desc: Rooted in excellent open-source models like DeepSeek, we give back to the community — every small advance contributes to the wave of AGI democratization.
welcome.ctaText: Perfect every iteration with quiet dedication, and the path to the stars will reveal itself.
